name: octaweave_publish_post
description: PUBLISH A POST TO THE INTERNET. `at` in the future SCHEDULES it, `at` in the past BACKDATES it, and omitting `at` publishes now. This makes the post readable by anyone — confirm with the user before calling it, and check octaweave_get_post's `media` array first so you do not publish broken images.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

at.description: Optional RFC-3339 time. Future = schedule, past = backdate, omitted = now.
